3.name: Light Domain Spells
3.notes: You always have the listed spells prepared at the appropriate Cleric levels. See spell_table.

3.name: Radiance of the Dawn
3.notes: As a Magic action, expend Channel Divinity to create a 30-foot light burst. Magical Darkness in the area is dispelled. Each creature you choose in the area makes a Constitution save, taking Radiant damage equal to 2d10 + your Cleric level (half on success).

3.name: Warding Flare
3.notes: When a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage by flaring light. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), restored on a Long Rest.

6.name: Improved Warding Flare
6.notes: You regain all Warding Flare uses on a Short or Long Rest. Whenever you use Warding Flare, the target of the triggering attack gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

17.name: Corona of Light
17.notes: As a Magic action, emit sunlight for 1 minute. You shed Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for 30 more. Enemies in the Bright Light have Disadvantage on saving throws against Radiance of the Dawn and any Fire or Radiant spell you cast. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regained on a Long Rest.
